OzyVTT · polish · shared parts

Shared parts

Every side list, title row, menu, phone sheet and dialog in the approved mockups after the consistency sweeps' fixes, the section bars, phone headers, tabs, toolbars, fields and tags the second sweep added, the buttons, phone controls, switches, ticks, steps rails, groups and GM ONLY tags the third added, and the eyebrows, notices, dialog and sheet titles, title rows and the Compendium's chips the fourth added, and the kind cards, bars, tags, closes, steppers, tabs, fields, lamps, marks, titles and Dawn's coloured words the fifth added, captured as each mockup now draws it. A cyan frame and number mark a capture a fix changed (2.n for the second sweep, 3.n for the third, 4.n for the fourth, 5.n for the fifth). The rules are the theme's 13 to 21; history/1-sweep.html to history/5-sweep.html are the sweeps as they were shown, history/3-before-after.html sets each of the third sweep's fixes before and after, and the fourth and fifth sweeps' pages do the same for their own.

The seven fixes

Made in the approved mockups and their specs on 2026-10-30, at the owner's word.

1

One side list

Settings and Time and tools

Settings' list, its search results and the tools in Settings are drawn as the settled side list (T rule 13, ADR-0071).

2

Faces on people's rows

F3, the Downtime tab

Each character in the Downtime tab's list carries their face at 20 px.

3

The crumb sits on the title's line

F, time and tools; H; I, its leftovers

Prep templates, the calendar, a screen's remote, an operation and a credential's page put the crumb inline before the title, with the back chevron (T rule 14).

4

A menu about one thing names it

F3; E2; C3, running

The pin's menu, a map's menu, a creature's menu and the encounter's options open with the name in display capitals and its line (T rule 15).

5

A phone sheet opens one way

C3, C5, D, E2, E3, F, G, I

Every sheet opens with the handle, then its title and the close button (T rule 16).

6

No count in an eyebrow

F3, the Atlas

The Atlas's list says MAPS; its counts sit on the rows.

7

The Atlas tree's rows

F3, the Atlas

Each map's row has the map icon and its pin count; what the map is sits in its line on the map's glass.

The second sweep's eleven fixes

Made the same day, at the owner's word.

2.1

One primary in view

F, F3, G, E3, H

When a page shows its own Cup the bar's New steps down to a Base line button with its +; with two, the step's or panel's keeps the Cup (T rule 2).

2.2

What a phone header names

F, F3, G's pages, H, E3

A section's page names the section; a record shows Back and where it goes, its title in the content (T rule 12).

2.3

Strips a later round changed

F, F3, H

The story's four tabs everywhere, Prep's seven pages, the Codex bar's More after New.

2.4

A list has no title row

E3, replays

Replays' toolbar opens with "5 replays" (T rule 17).

2.5

A list's count and sort

F, G, G's pages, E2

The count in plain words; sort as the sort icon and its word (T rule 17).

2.6

Fields

E2, F, F3, I's leftovers

A choice field's caret at its right end; a find field's icon and muted placeholder (T rule 18).

2.7

The Cup is words only

I, I's leftovers, G, G's pages

New credential and New homebrew lose their +.

2.8

Who sees a replay

E3, replays

The eye in the dim text colour when shared, violet when only you see it (T rule 9).

2.9

A map's kind

E2

The map icon and "Battle map" in its line, as a kind (T rule 19).

2.10

A player watching a replay

E3, replays

The menu button is the face alone; Table lit on the laptop as on the phone.

2.11

Which side list rows carry an icon

T rule 13

A row naming a kind of thing has its icon or face; a row that filters has none.

Side lists

An eyebrow with no count; one row a thing, its name and its count, with its icon or face when it names a kind of thing; the chosen lit with the cyan edge.

Title rows

A record opens with its title row, the crumb inline before the title. A section or a tool page names itself in its head.

Records and pages with a crumb

Section heads

Menus

A menu about one thing opens with its name in display capitals and its line; a menu that offers a choice opens with its eyebrow.

Phone sheets

The handle, then the title and the close button over a hairline.

Dialogs

A's dialog: the title on the horizon edge, the close at the right.

Section bars

The section, its pages, its search, then its New: the Cup, or a Base line button when the page shows its own (T rule 2).

Phone headers

A section names itself over its strip; a record shows Back and where it goes (T rule 12).

Tabs

One row of tabs, the chosen one inked (T rule 1).

Toolbars

The count in plain words, filters, sort as its icon and word, then the list's own action (T rule 17).

Fields

A choice field's caret at its right end; a find field's icon and muted placeholder (T rule 18).

Tags

A state as a boxed tag, a kind as its icon and word, readiness as a lamp and words (T rule 19).
